name: browser/read-page
title: Read one page
summary: Read one web page and answer from it: fetch it, find the passage that answers, quote the figure, give the URL.
when: Use when the user gives one web address or asks what a single page says and the answer must come from that page.
steps: Call browser action open with the exact address to get the page text and numbered links.
Read the passage that answers the question. For a JavaScript page with no readable text, retry once with mode headless.
If the answer is linked from the page, use browser action follow and the observed link_number.
Copy the figure or sentence exactly as printed, with its unit and the heading it appears under.
If the browser reports a host or timeout error, report that the page could not be read.
Mark any figure, date or link the page does not hold as not found; never fill it from memory.
Answer in two or three sentences, quote the exact figure, cite the page as [1] with its URL, and name what was missing.
next: The final answer must quote the sentence or figure from the fetched page, cite it as [1] with its URL, and mark anything the page did not hold as not found.
